blocks.text:
event clicked;int cardmode = 1
int address = 1
int sector = 0
int count=0
long snr
int size
UINT tagtype
string data32,databuff32
int st

data32=space(50)
databuff32=space(50)
string hexkey = "ffffffffffff"


st = ic_card( icdev, cardmode, ref snr)
If st <> 0 Then
      lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_card()函数出错")
      //return
End If
lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_card()函数成功")
lb_1.additem (string(snr))
 

st = ic_load_keyhex(icdev, 0, sector,  hexkey)
If st <> 0 Then
      lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_Load_key_hex()函数出错!")
      //return
End If
lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_Load_key_hex()函数成功!")

 
st = ic_authentication( icdev, 0, sector)
If st <> 0 Then
      lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_authentication()函数出错!")
		//return
End If
lb_1.AddItem( "调用 dc_authentication()函数成功!")
 


address=sector*4+2
data32 = "1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef"
st = IC_WriteMifare_Hex( icdev, address,  ref data32)
If st <> 0 Then
      lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_write_hex()函数出错!")
      //return
End If
lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_write_hex()函数成功!")


 


st = IC_ReadMifare_Hex( icdev, address, ref databuff32)
If st <> 0 Then
     lb_1.AddItem ("调用 dc_read_hex函数出错")
     //return
End If
lb_1.AddItem( "调用  h  dc_read_hex函数成功")
lb_1.additem(databuff32)
 
end event
